title: Improvement of garden and front yard of Deep Bhavan , Mumbai
summary: Civil and horticulture works to improve the garden and front yard of the Deep Bhavan office building of the Mumbai Directorate at Ghatkopar (East): lawn turfing, relaying and new paver blocks, concrete pavement, PU floor coating and repainting of the main and wicket gates.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Mumbai

sites.name: Deep Bhavan, M.G. Road, Ghatkopar (East), Mumbai - 400 077
sites.work: Improvement of garden and front yard: brickwork, plaster, exterior paint, lawn, paver blocks, CC pavement, PU floor coat, gate painting

scope.item: Brick work with common burnt clay F.P.S. (non modular) bricks of class designation 7.5 in superstructure, cement mortar 1:4
15 mm thick cement plaster in cement mortar 1:4 on rough side of single or half brick thick wall
Finishing walls with 1st quality Premium Acrylic Smooth exterior paint with Silicone additives (Asian/ Snowcem/ Berger) on new work
Anti termite treatment of lawn area with premise 30.50% (two application)
Supplying and stacking screened dump manure at site (sieve 4.75 mm), carriage up to 5 km
Mixing earth and sludge or manure and spreading in required thickness
Providing and laying Neelgiri/Mexican grass turf with earth 50-60 mm, rolling, watering and maintenance for 30 days or more
Taking out existing CC interlocking paver blocks from footpath/ central verge, disposal and stacking
Providing and laying cement concrete 1:2:4 (40 mm aggregate) in pavements
Laying old cement concrete interlocking paver blocks over 50 mm compacted bed of coarse sand
Providing and laying 60 mm thick M-35 cement concrete paver block, factory made chamfered edge, over 50 mm sand bed with plate vibrator compaction
Providing and applying Polyurethane (PU) floor paint/coat over old paver block surfaces - internal pathway/road (Asian/Indigo/Dulux)
Removal of synthetic enamel paint by brushing, scrapping, sand papering and surface preparation
Painting two or more coats with primer and 1st quality synthetic enamel paint (Asian/ Berger/ Shalimar) over previously painted Main gate and Wicket Gate

money.performance_security: 5% of contract value (FDR or bank guarantee) plus 5% security deposit deducted from each RA bill
money.notes: Estimated cost inclusive of GST (BOQ total Rs 6,60,371.00). Percentage rate BOQ. EMD by DD/FDR in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Mumbai, valid three months from technical bid opening; MSME/NSIC registered bidders must also pay EMD. Tender fee Nil. Security deposit released after 6 months defect liability period. Labour cess 1% deducted from RA bills. LD 0.5% per week, max 10%.

period.completion: 30 days from the date of award of contract
period.bid_validity: 90 days from the date of opening of technical bid
period.warranty: 6 months maintenance / defect liability period from completion

eligibility: Registered licensed contractors/firms of appropriate category with Central Govt/State Govt/Municipal Corporation etc. having tender limits equal to or more than the estimated cost

Similar works (development of gardens, civil works and similar) completed in last 7 years in Central/State/PSU/reputed firms: three works each >= 40% (Rs 2.64 lakh), or two works each >= 60% (Rs 3.96 lakh), or one work >= 80% (Rs 5.28 lakh) of estimated cost; certificate from officer not below Executive Engineer; sub-contractor experience not considered
Average annual turnover at least 30% of estimated cost (Rs 1,98,111) over last 3 financial years, CA certified
PAN, GST registration, income tax returns for last three years
Tender acceptance letter, unconditional bid undertaking, bid securing declaration, non-blacklisting affidavit, no-relatives declaration, Make in India self-certification
Technical evaluation by marks (statutory 30, financial 20, experience 20, performance 20, key personnel 10); minimum 70% to qualify; lowest rate among qualified bidders wins
specs: Work per CPWD specifications including CPWD Horticulture & Landscaping specifications
53 grade OPC/sulphate resisting cement from approved manufacturers with ISI mark
Paint shades: snow white/brilliant white and black for main gate/wicket gate; brick red for paver block; yellow oxide
Paint makes as per BOQ: Asian/Snowcem/Berger exterior acrylic; Asian/Indigo/Dulux PU floor coat; Asian/Berger/Shalimar synthetic enamel
